{{Quote|My father died when I was only an infant. Burdened with the responsibilities of being the head of our house, my mother left it to the servants to raise me. They knew of my special gifts for many years before word of it ever reached my mother's ear.|Hetton|<ref name="RoT" />}}
'''Hetton's family''' was a powerful [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] that consisted of [[Hetton|himself]], his [[Hetton's father|father]], and his mother, [[Loranda]]. Being distantly related to [[House Demici/Legends|House Demici]], one of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]], Hetton's family held some sway in planetary politics. The crest of the house was a [[Color/Legends|gold]] eight-pointed star, which the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] suspected was derived from the five-pointed star of House Demici.<ref name="RoT" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hetton's family first appeared in the novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', the second volume of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']].<ref name="RoT" />
